_comment_agent: Plain by-value struct (uint32_t self_size; int top, bottom, left, right; AVRational qoffset), no pointer field and no lifecycle routine of its own. It never stands alone in C: it is the element of AV_FRAME_DATA_REGIONS_OF_INTEREST side data, an array whose element count is the payload size over the first element's self_size and whose stride is self_size; frame.h requires self_size == sizeof(AVRegionOfInterest) (vf_addroi writes that). Readers (vf_showinfo dump_roi, vf_addroi, libx264, libx265, libvpxenc, vaapi_encode, qsvenc, d3d12va_encode) check only self_size != 0 and size % self_size == 0, then read a whole 28-byte struct at every stride: a nonzero self_size below sizeof passes and reads past the payload (ASan heap-buffer-overflow in vf_showinfo.c:151 and vf_addroi.c:139 for self_size 4 on a 28-byte payload; review buffer-frame wave-1 batch-0, misc/region-of-interest-self-size-hazards). self_size == 0 is an error in most readers but vf_addroi aborts the process (av_assert0, vf_addroi.c:119). qoffset is not range-checked: encoders refuse den == 0 only; d3d12va_encode.c:239 computes num * qp_range / den in int (overflow) and libvpxenc.c:1610 converts num/den*MAX_DELTA_Q to int unchecked, so values outside [-1, 1] can be C UB there. Nothing allocates, frees or copies one except as side-data bytes, so all-zero is a valid Rust value; but any safe wrapper that hands a REGIONS_OF_INTEREST payload to C (side data stores, filters, encoders) must check every element's self_size == sizeof (and the qoffset range for the encoders above) first. No field is range-checked by libavutil. Wrapped (buffer-frame wave 1 batch 0) as the ffibox value type RegionOfInterest (CZeroable, Copy, Send + Sync as plain data): RegionOfInterest::new and Default set self_size to sizeof; RegionOfInterestRef getters for every field (qoffset as a RationalRef over the projected place), RegionOfInterestMut setters, qoffset_mut and whole-value set/get.
